fullPassage: "Where could it be?" Sophie asked herself. It had been more than ten years since she had last visited the area where she had grown up. The village had changed a lot over time. Uncertain, she awkwardly looked around at her surroundings. She walked the narrow streets of the village, unsure about which way to go. Suddenly, Sophie saw a familiar sight. "Yes, this must be it," she thought. In front of her was a wall with flowers painted on it. Although the colors were now faded, the familiar shapes on the wall were the same ones she had painted with her father as a child. Sophie nodded, smiled brightly, and walked toward the gate. At last, she had finally found the house she had grown up in.

❌ ① change → changed: had changed(과거완료)이므로 과거분사 필요
✅ ② familiar: 형용사로 올바름
✅ ③ faded: 형용사/과거분사로 올바름
✅ ④ child: as a child로 올바름
det.tip: had + p.p.(과거분사): had changed(과거완료)

questions.passage: "Where could it be?" Sophie asked herself. It had been more than ten years since she had last visited the area where she had grown up. The village had changed a lot over time. Uncertain, she awkwardly looked around at her surroundings. She walked the narrow streets of the village, __________ about which way to go. Suddenly, Sophie saw a familiar sight. "Yes, this must be it," she thought. In front of her was a wall with flowers painted on it. Although the colors were now faded, the familiar shapes on the wall were the same ones she had painted with her father as a child. Sophie nodded, smiled brightly, and walked toward the gate. At last, she had finally found the house she had grown up in.
questions.stem: 윗글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 어느 길로 가야 할지 확신이 없는(unsure) 상태입니다. Uncertain과 같은 맥락의 감정입니다.
det.analysis:
✅ unsure: Uncertain과 같은 맥락으로 확신 없는 상태에 적절
❌ excited: 흥분한 감정은 이 시점의 맥락과 맞지 않음
❌ determined: 결심한 상태는 불확실한 상황과 모순
❌ relieved: 안도감은 아직 집을 찾기 전이므로 부적절
det.tip: Uncertain → unsure: 같은 맥락의 불확실한 감정
